name: chart_lib_url
label: Chart.js URL
hint: Loaded by the widget only if window.Chart is not already defined. The preferred route is an sp_js_include on an sp_dependency attached to this widget, which makes this fallback a no-op. Point it at a local UI Script if the portal cannot reach a CDN — no code change is needed, only this value.

name: trend_months
label: Months in the trend
hint: How many months the trend covers, ending at the selected month. Clamped server-side to 1–36; the user can change it within that range from the chart's span picker.

name: team_limit
label: People in the comparison chart
hint: Maximum bars in the per-person comparison, ranked by cost (or by shift count when pay amounts are hidden). Clamped server-side to 1–100 — a bar chart of every employee is not a report.

name: show_pay_amounts
label: Show pay amounts
hint: When off, no monetary value is sent to the browser at all — the charts and tables show shift counts only, and the team ranking switches to count so the ordering cannot leak the withheld amounts. Enforced server-side, not just hidden in the template.

name: enable_co_entitlement
label: Enable CO entitlement rules
hint: Must match the same option on the employee calendar and the approval widget. When off, the CO health tab is not offered and the entitlement table is never read.

name: manager_field
label: Manager field on sys_user
hint: Field on sys_user holding the line manager. Decides who may select the 'My team' scope and whose data it covers. Keep in step with the same option on the approval widget.

name: org_role
label: Role required for organisation scope
hint: Only holders of this role are offered the 'Organisation' scope, which reads every user's data with no user filter. Checked server-side on every request — the scope selector is a convenience, not the control.

name: summary_table
label: Aggregate summary table
hint: Table name. Monthly rows (u_period_type = month) are the source of every figure on this widget, including the rate snapshot in u_amount.

name: catalog_table
label: Shift catalogue table
hint: Table name. Active rows supply chart colours (color_hex), names, and the allow_weekday / allow_weekend_holiday flags that define which shift types count as on-call load.

name: entitlement_table
label: CO entitlement table
hint: Table name. Read only by the CO health tab, and only when CO entitlement rules are enabled.

name: lock_table
label: Monthly timesheet table
hint: Table name. Supplies the submitted / approved / rejected counts in the stat strip, which is what stops an unsubmitted current month reading as a drop in cost.
